# gRNA Design

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. The connector generates a readable
experiment name when one is omitted; report the returned name. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## CRISPR Base Editing

Design guide RNAs for adenine or cytosine base editing of a target gene.

Exact job name: `crispr_base_editing`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gene_id` | string | yes | value | A target gene identifier/symbol. The live test used `HPRT1`. |
| `editor_type` | string | yes | value | Exact value `ABE` or `CBE`; do not send labels, objects, lowercase variants, or invented editor names. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "gene_id": {
      "description": "A target gene identifier/symbol. The live test used `HPRT1`.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "editor_type": {
      "description": "Exact value `ABE` or `CBE`; do not send labels, objects, lowercase variants, or invented editor names.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "ABE",
        "CBE"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "gene_id",
    "editor_type"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json
{
  "job_name": "crispr_base_editing",
  "experiment_name": "<optional; generated if omitted>",
  "experiment_data": {
    "gene_id": "<user value; see gene_id schema>",
    "editor_type": "<user value; see editor_type schema>"
  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.

## CRISPR IndelShift Prediction

Predict CRISPR indel / frameshift outcomes for guide RNAs (Lindel-based on-/off-target model).

Exact job name: `crispr_fs_score`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_csv` | string | yes | file | CSV of guide RNAs. Upload via `file_upload` first, then pass the returned platform path. Headers MUST be exactly: `grna_id, chromosome, genomic_position, strand, protospacer, pam` |
| `aligner` | string | yes | value | Aligner used to map guide-RNA spacers and locate target/off-target sites; proven value `"biostrings"` (lowercase) |
| `mismatches` | integer | yes | value | Number of allowed mismatches for off-target mapping — INTEGER (e.g. `5`) |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "input_csv": {
      "description": "CSV of guide RNAs. Upload via `file_upload` first, then pass the returned platform path. Headers MUST be exactly: `grna_id, chromosome, genomic_position, strand, protospacer, pam`",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "aligner": {
      "description": "Aligner used to map guide-RNA spacers and locate target/off-target sites; proven value `\"biostrings\"` (lowercase)",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "biostrings"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "mismatches": {
      "description": "Number of allowed mismatches for off-target mapping — INTEGER (e.g. `5`)",
      "type": "integer",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "input_csv",
    "aligner",
    "mismatches"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope
